shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,290p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,230p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '1,240p' src/types/ai.ts && printf '\\nCOMMANDS\\n' && cat .lore/test-commands.yml && printf '\\nPACKAGE\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\nSTATUS\\n' && git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"ToolRegistry|tool_use|UsageMetadata|specs/\" src/orchestration/*.test.ts | head -120 && sed -n '290,700p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && rg -n \"spec anchor|@spec|spec:\" src scripts | head -100 && ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true && ls .lore"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '55,100p' && git diff --check && npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "test usage aggregation across tool rounds" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
